scientific_question: Does the Hahn1-derived prediction-domain and minimal numerical-identifiability gate generalize to the untouched NIST Thurber cubic/cubic rational dataset without model or threshold retuning?

selection_scope.selection_rationale: Same seven-parameter cubic/cubic equation as Hahn1 but a different NIST semiconductor electron-mobility experiment; only the published equation, starts, certified values and raw observations were inspected before freezing
selection_scope.prospective_meaning: Dataset-prospective computational validation, not an independent physical experiment or external preregistration

data.name: NIST/ITL StRD Thurber
data.units_as_published: y is electron mobility; x is the natural log of density; no unit conversion or measurement uncertainty is invented

model.bounds: Unbounded coefficients as published by NIST; denominator admissibility is evaluated separately
model.optimizer: scipy.optimize.curve_fit with method=lm, maxfev=200000, full_output=true; select the lowest training residual sum of squares
model.parameter_changes_from_hahn1: None; use only the published Thurber starts and equation

fold_rule.construction: Sort unique x values and split into five contiguous, nearly equal groups; every repeated x stays in one group; each group is tested once while the other four groups are fitted
fold_rule.leakage_control: No shared x between fitting and test observations; every observation is evaluated exactly once
fold_rule.baseline: Ordinary least-squares cubic polynomial fitted only on the other four groups
fold_rule.retuning: No start, model, threshold or fold changes after seeing test results

prediction_domain_gate.real_root_rule: numpy.roots for 1+b5*x+b6*x^2+b7*x^3; absolute imaginary part below 1e-8; reject a numerical real root inside the closed held-out x interval
prediction_domain_gate.dense_grid_rule: Evaluate 1001 evenly spaced points spanning the closed held-out x interval; reject non-finite values, exact zeros or denominator sign changes
prediction_domain_gate.observation_rule: Every held-out model prediction and denominator must be finite and every held-out denominator must be nonzero
prediction_domain_gate.scope: Numerical admissibility on the held-out interval, not an exact algebraic proof outside it

minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.jacobian: Analytic training Jacobian at the frozen fit
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.column_scaling: Euclidean-norm column scaling before singular-value analysis
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.rank_rule: Require numerical rank 7 using tolerance max(matrix shape)*machine_epsilon*largest_scaled_singular_value
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.covariance_rule: Local linearized parameter standard errors must be finite and positive using pseudo-inverse rcond=1e-12
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.diagnostics_not_gates: Report scaled condition number and maximum absolute off-diagonal parameter correlation without retrospective cutoffs
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.scope: Minimal local numerical check only; full rank does not prove global structural identifiability or physical endogeneity

decision_rules.domain_admissible: Finite optimizer result and all prediction-domain checks pass
decision_rules.minimal_numerical_identifiability: Numerical rank 7 and finite positive local standard errors
decision_rules.fold_gated_limited_support: Domain-admissible AND minimal numerical identifiability AND held-out RMSE <= cubic-baseline held-out RMSE
decision_rules.overall_all_folds_gated_support: All five folds satisfy fold_gated_limited_support; otherwise report every failed fold and gate
decision_rules.interpretation: A computational limited-support gate for this dataset and protocol, never a universal law or independent experimental replication

full_fit_certification_rule.purpose: Known-answer implementation check only; never used as held-out evidence
